_about: Rules table (review/05c-rules-register.md R-001..R-054). Every rule carries a source category: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED, PAYER-SPECIFIC, HARVEST-REPORTED, UNVERIFIED-DEMO-ASSUMPTION. Edited only through the settings.rule action (admin.settings). Changes are audited and apply forward only.

rules.label: Follow-up call on the decision
rules.source: Receipt/decision follow-up call about day 10 (Plaud P-057; v3 rule day10)
rules.note: Shown as "Day N" with a follow-up chip. Harvest-reported, not a payer deadline.

rules.label: Decision overdue after
rules.source: Harvest believes payers take up to 14 days (P-058, T-012); some exceed a month
rules.note: Red "Overdue" appears only after this many days. Not stated as law.

rules.label: Public decision standard (reference)
rules.source: PsyFlo compilation (T-076): federal standard from 1 Jan 2026; v3 cites a federal rule nobody on the team has opened; applicability to Virginia MCOs unconfirmed
rules.note: Reference only. Never drives a date or a status.

rules.label: Expedited decision (reference)
rules.source: PsyFlo compilation (T-076)
rules.note: Reference only; off.

rules.label: Clock restarts after an information reply
rules.source: None found
rules.note: Do not assume the payer restarts its clock.

rules.label: Receipt check call
rules.source: Receipt call about day 10 (P-057; v3 rule day10); the master used day 5 for Humana only
rules.note: One rule for every payer until Harvest gives per-payer values.

rules.label: Information request: reply window
rules.source: Each payer message states its own deadline and that wins; Anthem turnaround of about 24 h (T-015, P-060)
rules.note: Use the due time in the payer message; 24 h is the fallback. Calendar hours, so a Friday request is due Saturday.

rules.label: Outpatient pend response
rules.source: Appendix H not in Drive (T-015, T-076)
rules.note: Not applied to TDT.

rules.label: Information replies by licensed clinical staff
rules.note: Enforced: only the clinician role replies.

rules.label: Initial SRA sent within
rules.source: Initial SRA within 30 days of intake (P-053, T-016); not in Chapter IV
rules.note: Harvest practice. The start event is configurable.

rules.label: Start event for the 30 days
rules.source: Three start points appear in the sources (CK-5)
rules.note: One configured start event.

rules.label: No backdating of the request start
rules.source: P-053; the "no payment before authorization" line sits in the intensive in-home paragraph (T-073)
rules.note: Unverified for TDT.

rules.label: Retro review request field
rules.source: Initial SRA form, July 2021 (T-074)
rules.note: Field exists on the official form.

rules.label: Plan due (Harvest practice)
rules.source: LPC, firm (P-035); the advisor was unsure (T-008)
rules.note: Internal target. Shown beside the official rule.

rules.label: Plan due (DMAS)
rules.unit: calendar days from the start of services
rules.source: DMAS Chapter IV: ISP within 30 calendar days of starting services (T-070)
rules.note: Shown with the Harvest practice, never replaced by it.

rules.label: ISP review
rules.source: Chapter IV: reviewed at least every 90 calendar days (T-070)
rules.note: The 15-day signature detail is from v3 only.

rules.label: ISP updated at least
rules.source: Updated after hospitalization or a higher level of care and at least yearly (P-040)

rules.label: Daily note completed within
rules.source: Harvest KPI (G-049); no 24-hour text in Chapter IV (T-020, T-072)
rules.note: Label: "Harvest target". Not stated as a Medicaid rule.

rules.label: Weekly guardian contact
rules.source: Family contacts at least weekly (Chapter IV, T-070); the Friday cut-off is Harvest practice

rules.label: Monthly collateral contact
rules.source: T-022; monthly per outside provider (P-101)

rules.label: Progress note elements
rules.source: Chapter IV progress-note requirements; duplicates not paid (T-072)
rules.note: Stored for display; no automated enforcement.

rules.label: Trainee notes supervisor-reviewed
rules.source: Trainee notes must be supervisor-reviewed (T-019)

rules.label: Level 2 and 3 incidents to the state portal within
rules.source: Clinic lead (P-141); licensing source not in Drive
rules.note: Levels 2-3.

rules.label: Daily direct minimum
rules.source: Chapter IV and 12VAC30-50-130: at least 2 hours a day with at least 2 therapeutic activities (T-070, T-073); Harvest staff say 1 hour (T-021)
rules.note: Not displayed as a rule until Harvest confirms (1 h or 2 h).

rules.label: Therapeutic activities per day
rules.source: Chapter IV (T-070)
rules.note: Not displayed until the minimum is confirmed.

rules.label: Largest group
rules.source: Group activities hold no more than 10 youth (T-070)

rules.label: Daily units from direct time
rules.source: 12VAC30-80-30 A.3.c and Chapter IV: 2-2.99 h = 1, 3-4.99 h = 2, 5 h or more = 3 (T-068); the same text also carries a second legacy-looking schedule, so verify against the live code
rules.note: Below 120 minutes earns 0 units. Daily maximum 3.

rules.label: Alternate unit bands (60-minute rule)
rules.source: The master used 1 unit from 60 minutes; no source found
rules.note: Alternate configurable value only. To use it, an administrator copies it into units.tdt.day_tiers (change is audited, forward only).

rules.label: Run-out rate
rules.source: None: needs a per-student rate from recent notes and a school calendar (README open question)
rules.note: Default for projections only; always shown with its assumption.

rules.label: Not reimbursable time
rules.source: Chapter IV (T-070)
rules.note: Track Time separates recorded, direct, documented and potentially billable time.

rules.label: Claim modifiers
rules.source: Modifiers: none school day, UG after school, U7 summer (T-068)

rules.label: Continued stay submitted before the end date
rules.source: MCO continued stay submitted 14 business days ahead, payer unnamed (T-076); Harvest reapplies when units run low (U-8)
rules.note: Per payer; alternative trigger is units remaining.

rules.label: Late continued-stay request
rules.value: Late submissions are not rejected; untimely days or units are denied.
rules.note: Display only.
rules.default: Late submissions are not rejected; untimely days or units are denied.

rules.label: Discharge after a lapse in service
rules.source: Chapter IV: a lapse of more than 31 consecutive calendar days requires discharge (T-070, T-071)
rules.note: Harvest also quotes 30 days; both are shown.

rules.label: Discharge after no billable service (Harvest)
rules.note: Conflicts with the official 31 days; shown as internal practice.

rules.label: Earliest new initial after an early discharge
rules.source: No document supports a 30-day gap (T-016, U-4)
rules.note: Set by the clinician. The words "DMAS rule" must not appear.

rules.label: Monitoring plan with an early discharge
rules.source: Design rule (G-073)

rules.label: CNA outdated after no service for
rules.source: CNA by an LMHP-type, face to face, 15 elements (T-071)
rules.note: Annual review also applies.

rules.label: Clinical criteria needed
rules.source: Initial SRA form and Chapter IV (T-074)

rules.label: Level-of-care criteria needed
rules.source: Initial SRA form and Chapter IV (T-074)

rules.label: Leave criterion 3 blank when 1 and 2 are met
rules.source: PsyFlo drafting rule 9; the clinician decides
rules.note: Design rule, not a regulation.

rules.label: Prior service carries
rules.source: P-030, P-050; Chapter IV p. 6 per v3 (failed services definition)

rules.label: Evidence from the last
rules.source: Insurers want the last 30 days (T-023)

rules.label: Counts, never percentages
rules.source: Design rule; the forms ask for frequency, intensity, duration (T-074)

rules.label: Words to flag, never rewrite
rules.source: Auditors look for the verb (T-024)
rules.note: Flag and ask what staff did.

rules.label: Who may sign an SRA
rules.source: LMHP-type attestation; credentials, NPI on the initial form only (T-074)
rules.note: The signer is always read from the Lauris signature event.

rules.label: Electronic signature on SRA forms
rules.source: "Actual or electronic" on both SRA forms (T-074)

rules.label: Guardian signature: consent for services
rules.source: Harvest practice is in person (P-016, T-007); the DMAS SRA forms accept electronic signature; policy not validated
rules.note: Chip: policy not validated. Switching to in_person_required changes the family screens.

rules.label: Guardian signature: release of information
rules.source: As above
rules.note: Policy not validated.

rules.label: Guardian signature: enrollment packet
rules.source: As above
rules.note: Policy not validated.

rules.label: Guardian signature: quarterly report
rules.source: May sign by phone if allowed (P-022)
rules.note: Policy not validated.

rules.label: Guardian signature: appeal letter
rules.source: Open (T-017)
rules.note: Policy not validated.

rules.label: Eligibility re-check
rules.source: One payer's auditor, relayed (T-025, T-026, U-9); no document in Drive
rules.note: Harvest chooses N. Demo scenario. Each check records date, person and source.

rules.label: Eligibility checked only after the family link
rules.source: PsyFlo decision, 8 Nov contract

rules.label: Guardian appeal window
rules.source: Federal text cited by v3 (42 CFR 438.402(c)(2)(ii)), not opened by the team; start date and the Virginia process unverified (T-081)
rules.note: Chip: federal rule cited, confirm on the notice.

rules.label: Appeal window starts
rules.source: v3 rule appeal-60
rules.note: Store the notice date.

rules.label: Reconsideration
rules.source: T-076, T-079; contradicted by the research notes (T-081)
rules.note: Off.

rules.label: Who may appeal
rules.source: Open (T-017); v3 rule row: a provider with written consent, 42 CFR 438.402(c)(1)(ii)
rules.note: Provider path: not verified. The system prepares; the guardian signs.

rules.label: EPSDT note
rules.value: No denial as not medically necessary without physician review (EPSDT).
rules.source: PsyFlo relay of a DMAS statement (T-080)
rules.note: Display only.
rules.default: No denial as not medically necessary without physician review (EPSDT).

rules.label: Peer-to-peer attempts
rules.source: T-014; v3 rule p2p-wait (Sentara)
rules.note: One shot, one to two months out.

rules.label: Record peer-to-peer calls
rules.source: NEXT-STEPS open question; legal review first
rules.note: Off.

rules.label: Recording needs a recorded consent
rules.source: PsyFlo rule T-060 for its own tools; legal basis unverified

rules.label: Payer channels
rules.source: Harvest channels (P-055); PsyFlo brief says FFS is portal-only and Aetna fax-preferred (T-076, T-077, U-13)
rules.note: Per-payer category: Harvest-reported until a payer document is seen.

rules.label: UnitedHealthcare packet attachments
rules.source: Seed; v3 mco-docs unverified

rules.label: Smallest group shown in analytics
rules.source: Design rule (build brief rule 7); 05c proposed 10
rules.note: Cells below the minimum are suppressed. No patient-level drill-down outside case-backed data plus the clinical-records permission.

rules.label: Analytics datasets
rules.source: Harvest has not computed the seeded figures (T-045, T-067)
rules.note: One dataset per view, never summed. harvest_export is labelled "Sample data, illustrative".

rules.label: Family link expires after
rules.source: PsyFlo design rule
rules.note: Enforced on unsubmitted links.

rules.label: TDT redesign: service retires
rules.source: Automated PsyFlo digest, not official (T-078); Harvest does not expect the date to hold (T-032)
rules.note: Never used to compute a date or a unit.

rules.label: Redesign: CPST starts
rules.note: 15-minute units are discussed (G-077); information only.
